race.title: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap Chase
race.verdict: A very thin race in which HONEY JACK might be able to make a winning start over fences for the in-form Tizzard yard. Point winner Lifetime In Milan could surpass his hurdles form now chasing, with Kitsilano making most appeal of those with experience. HONEY JACK LIFETIME IN MILAN (IRE) KITSILANO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Honey Jack (2/1), Ballybay (9/4), Kitsilano (9/2), Poncho (11/2), Lifetime In Milan (10/1), Pop's Folly (14/1)
